pages.text: $(l)Hardened planks$()$(br)Fill a $(item)stripped log$() with $(item)250 mB of creosote$() using a spout. Here is a use for the coke oven's creosote.

$(l)Steel casing$()$(br)Use a $(item)steel ingot$() on hardened planks: right-click the placed block, or let a deployer do it. It is the base of transformers, polarizers, engine gearboxes and steel doors.$(br2)$(l)Heavy machinery casing$()$(br)Use a $(item)heavy plate$() on a steel casing the same way. Engines, pumpjacks, the industrial mixer, machine inputs and many electrical parts need it.

$(l)Aluminium casing$()$(br)An $(item)aluminium sheet$() on a steel casing gives an aluminium casing.$(br2)Like Create's casings, these item applications work by hand on a placed block or with a deployer over a belt or depot, so they automate easily once you have a steady supply of plates.
The items this page talks about. Hover for details; JEI shows their recipes.
